activity.notes: Togay (Tuhay) Bey was a Crimean Khanate political and military figure associated with Or Qapı/Perekop and a major Crimean commander in alliance with Bohdan Khmelnytsky. He was not ruler of a generic 'Tatar Horde'; ATLAS binds him to the Crimean Khanate and records his Or Bey office conservatively from about 1644 until his death in 1651.

sources.title: ТУГАЙ-БЕЙ — Encyclopedia of History of Ukraine
sources.citation_text: The Institute of History of Ukraine identifies Tuhay Bey as a seventeenth-century political and military figure of the Crimean Khanate and a leading supporter of alliance with the Ukrainian Cossack state.
